objects.text: Candidate plan for T-A: use the latest constituent list for the entire historical sample. This is a proposal, not an accepted requirement.
For T-A I reject E-A1 because using the latest constituent list introduces survivorship bias. Use historical point-in-time constituent lists instead.
Data is ready for T-A. I suggest starting the backtest immediately.
Data coverage for T-A runs through 2022. This dataset record does not authorize executing a backtest.
